skill_name: Write an argumentative essay on why technology is necessary in the workplace.
workflow: In today's fast-paced and interdependent world, technology is essential in allowing businesses to remain competitive and efficient. Technology helps businesses save time and money by automating processes and streamlining workflow. It reduces manual labour, which is often time consuming and inefficient, and replaces it with advanced electronic tools that are far more accurate and reliable.
